summary: Reference copy of Brindlewythe Biosciences plate-acceptance training, lightly rebadged for Westravelle. Retains screening-control diagrams and adds a local cover note comparing plate acceptance with chromatographic system suitability. The current approved protocol governs acceptance criteria and repeat decisions.

slides.notes: Local cover note — Carla Smith: retained as a training reference. Screening plate acceptance illustrates a control-based reporting gate; apply Westravelle system suitability requirements to chromatographic sequences. This copy does not authorise a local screening procedure.

slides.title: 1 Purpose
bullets: Brindlewythe Biosciences reference: plate acceptance determines whether acquired screening data are suitable for interpretation and reporting
Confirm the plate map and required controls before acquisition; evaluate control signals and plate statistics after acquisition
Westravelle comparison: system suitability establishes whether a chromatographic sequence meets its method criteria

bullets.text: Use the approved protocol or method for the criteria, documentation and reporting decision; the two checks are not interchangeable

slides.notes: Local comparison added for Westravelle training; source screening terminology retained on the following slides.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 2 Plate acceptance checks

rows: Required control types and positions agree with the approved plate map
Hold reporting; document the discrepancy and assess under the protocol
Reject if the acceptance criterion fails; investigate before repeating
Background and variability meet the protocol criteria
Hold reporting and investigate the failure
Spatial effects assessed against the protocol criteria
Document and apply the pre-defined acceptance rule; no retrospective rescue
Calculated from acquired control-well signals as stated in the protocol
Apply the protocol criterion; retain rejected data without reporting them as accepted results

slides.notes: Acceptance windows and any permitted exclusions belong to the approved protocol. Record its revision with the plate record.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 3 Screening-control layout — retained reference diagram

boxes: Acquired control signals > Response windows and variability
Response windows and variability > Plate acceptance decision

slides.notes: Brindlewythe Biosciences training schematic; not a well-position map. Control and replicate positions follow the approved protocol. Do not move or exclude controls to rescue a failed plate. Evaluate spatial effects using the acquired data.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 4 Failed plates
bullets: Retain the failed plate data, plate map and acceptance assessment in the screening record
Document the plate identifier, failed criterion and investigation in the required deviation record
Repeat only as authorised by the approved protocol or documented investigation; preserve the link to the original plate
Escalate recurrent failures to the responsible scientific and quality reviewers before further work
slides.notes: Do not average rejected results into accepted repeat results. This reference copy sets no repeat allowance or escalation count.
slides.footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: 5 Plate acceptance and system suitability

boxes: Screening plate > Acquire control and compound signals
Acquire control and compound signals > Evaluate plate acceptance
Evaluate plate acceptance > Interpret accepted screening data
Chromatographic sequence > Evaluate method system suitability
Evaluate method system suitability > Release eligible sample results

slides.notes: Local comparison: plate records carry screening acceptance decisions; sequence sheets carry chromatographic system suitability entries. A pass in either workflow does not establish acceptance in the other. Review and sign-off follow the applicable approved procedure.
